questions.prompt: An Entra security group should automatically include enabled users whose department is Operations. Which membership approach fits?

options.text: Dynamic User with a department and accountEnabled rule.
options.explanation: Membership follows the stated user attributes after processing.
It requires explicit member maintenance rather than attribute evaluation.

options.text: Dynamic Device using device operating system.
options.explanation: Device properties cannot express this set of user departments.

options.text: An Azure resource tag named Operations.
options.explanation: Resource tags are not Entra group membership rules.

questions.prompt: An administrator cannot manually add a user to an Entra Dynamic User group. The user does not match its rule. What should be reviewed?

options.text: The rule and authoritative user attributes.
options.explanation: Dynamic membership is computed from eligibility rather than manual exceptions.

options.text: Make the user the group owner to guarantee membership.
options.explanation: Ownership is not a substitute for satisfying the dynamic rule.

options.text: Rename the group to the user's name.
options.explanation: The display name does not determine rule evaluation.

options.text: Assign Azure subscription Owner to the user.
options.explanation: Azure resource permissions do not override a directory membership rule.

questions.prompt: A tenant has 120 unique users across several Entra dynamic user groups. Which licensing approach matches the documented requirement?

options.text: Ensure eligible dynamic-membership licensing for all 120 unique users.
options.explanation: The requirement follows unique users covered by the feature.
An administrator license alone does not cover the members.

options.text: Buy one user license per group regardless of membership.
options.explanation: The requirement is not based only on group count.

options.text: Count the same user again for every dynamic group they join.
options.explanation: The documented count is unique users, not memberships.

questions.prompt: A cloud-managed Entra security group's description needs updating while applications must keep referring to the same group. Which action fits?

options.explanation: Its identity remains the existing object ID.

options.text: Delete the group and recreate the same name.
options.explanation: A recreated object has a different ID and can break assignments.
User names do not update group description.
A tenant migration is unnecessary for a property edit.
